title: 首屏
summary: 「做个高级首屏」只说了要花哨。先定第一眼回答什么：能解决什么、你是谁、为什么现在、卖什么、发生了什么、能学到什么、能帮我做什么，还是谁在这里。
summaryEn: “Make a fancy hero” only says it should look expensive. First decide what the first glance must answer: what it solves, who you are, why now, what is for sale, what happened, what you will learn, what it can do, or who is here.
asks: 打开第一眼要回答什么？
asksEn: What must the first glance answer?

links.whenEn: if the skeleton is already a landing page
the first fold is not a login card
